scope: Retain H = Z + 0.1 X, the one-qubit RY ansatz, zero initial angle, maximum 1000 iterations and final energy/parameter readout. Existing native R(theta, pi/2) expresses the same RY rotation. Use the existing local Nelder-Mead optimizer explicitly; the cloud optimizer method and iteration trace are not assumed identical. Each objective call actually synthesizes and runs the bound angle; there is no analytic solution substituted into optimization, runtime parameter binding or autograd claim.
